entries.633f625fe7c226b7: The company’s management philosophy is “Innovation and Creation,” and its purpose is to connect people, goods, information and services in the research, industrial and medical fields, supporting the activities of researchers and healthcare professionals. Its long-term vision “AS ONE VISION-2035,” formulated in May 2025, aims to create a platform where research resources are “visible, connected and within reach,” in order to resolve the “3 nai” (okane ga nai, jikan ga nai, mottainai) that researchers face: no money, no time, and waste. Under the medium-term management plan “FY2025-27” (covering the fiscal year ended March 2026 through the fiscal year ended March 2028), the company aims for sustained growth of its existing businesses and also targets discontinuous growth through active use of M&A and alliances.
